sections.brief: Hook: graded only by its answer, the agent is a black box. Frame 0 is the thumbnail: the title 'Booked. But how?' (h2, top band, pre-rolled so it reads at t=0) and the tape are already up at 0 (pre-roll the tape's entrance before 0.6 s), with a local 'black box' (a rect filled `bg`, stroke `line`, label 'agent' in muted, layered above the tape) covering cells 2–5 so only 'request' and 'answer' show. A small mono quote above cell 1 at 0: “Book the cheapest flight NYC → LA” (style small). cue:answer: light6 fills `score` (pop) — the answer passed. cue:box: the black box gets heavier (stroke goes `text`, a slight scale pulse, no bounce). cue:where: a red `fault` '?' pops on the box. From ~9.0 s: the box, '?', quote and title clear (the box lifts and fades) so the whole run shows; light6 back to empty by the end. End on key s1 (tape fully visible, all lights empty).

The agent loop, on the tape. Title 'Record the whole run' (h2, top band, at section start). A thin amber playhead (local line, `tape`, taller than the cells) appears at cell 1 and steps along the tape with the narration: cell 2 at cue:reason, cell 3 at cue:action, cell 4 at cue:observe, cell 6 at cue:done. cue:loop: a curved arrow (`muted`, bend so it arcs ABOVE the tape over the lights) from cell 4 back to cell 2, drawn on; small label 'loop'. cue:reason: cell 2's stroke goes `tape` and a label 'reasoning layer · LLM' (label style) appears below the tape under cell 2. cue:action: cells 3 and 5 stroke `tape`, label 'action layer · tools' under them. cue:observe: the loop arrow pulses once. cue:done: the playhead reaches cell 6. Lights stay empty (nothing is scored yet). End with clear: strokes back to `line`, all locals off, on key s2 (= key s1).

Reasoning layer failures and their two metrics (trajectory metrics). Title 'Reasoning: plan, then follow it' (h2, top band). A small local plan card rises above cell 2 at cue:plan (surface2, label 'plan · example'), its steps in mono: '1 book_flight' '2 search_flights' — out of order: line 1 turns `fault` and light2 turns `fault`. Then the lines swap into the right order (search first) and light2 goes back to empty. cue:drift: the plan is right, but a red dashed arrow (`fault`) shows the run jumping from cell 3 straight to cell 6, skipping cell 5 (book_flight never ran); cell 5 dims. cue:quality: next to the plan card, `PlanQualityMetric` (mono, `score`) appears with a teal light. cue:adherence: a teal bracket draws on under the whole tape (cells 2–6) labelled `PlanAdherenceMetric` (mono, `score`). End with clear, all lights empty, cell 5 back, on key s3.

Action layer failures — a walkthrough (docs/motion.md §7). Title 'Action: right tool, right arguments' (h2, top band, `hud: true` so the zoom never moves it). Just before cue:wrong: `focus` the camera on cell 3 (zoom about 1.6, 0.8 s, arrive ease) with a `spotlight` on cell 3 (opacity ~0.7). cue:wrong: cell 3's name is covered by a local mono 'calculator' in `fault` (the real name hidden under a surface rect or faded), light3 `fault`, and a `chip` 'needed: search_flights' beside it; hold ≥1.4 s. Before cue:args: the right name returns, light3 empty, chip goes. cue:args: an args card (local, surface2) rises below cell 3 with mono `{"city": "LA"}`. cue:location: under it, the tool's schema line in mono `expects: location` with an example `"Los Angeles, CA, USA"` (muted), and the 'city' key turns `fault`. cue:toolc: camera glides (focus) to cell 2, the LLM span that made the choice; spotlight moves with it; `ToolCorrectnessMetric` (mono, `score`) appears under cell 2 and light2 goes `score`. cue:argc: `ArgumentCorrectnessMetric` under it. ~1 s before the end: camera back to full (focus full), spotlight and locals clear, lights empty, on key s4.

Three scopes, as three ways of reading the same tape. Title 'Three scopes' (h2, top band). cue:e2e: cells 2–5 dim to ~0.3 and cells 1 and 6 get teal outlines; label 'end-to-end' (label, `score`) above the tape, a thin teal line linking cell 1 to cell 6 over the top. Lights 1 and 6 fill `score`. cue:traj: everything back to full; a teal bracket draws on under the whole tape, labelled 'trajectory'. cue:complete: light6 `score` (finished the task). cue:efficient: lights 2–5 fill `score` one by one, left to right (no wasted steps). cue:comp: all other lights and the bracket dim; a small teal bracket draws above cell 2 only, labelled 'component', cell 2 stroke `score`. Keep labels ≤2 words; no metric names here. End with clear, all lights empty, on key s5.

Development and production, then the end card (last section). Title 'Every failure becomes a test' (h2, top band). cue:goldens: the tape scales to ~0.6 and moves up under the title; below it a row of 5 small amber-edged cards (local, surface, stroke `tape`) labelled 'goldens · example', each with a tiny mono input line; small label 'development' on the left. cue:catch: label 'production' on the right; on the tape, cell 5's light goes `fault` and cell 5 strokes `fault` (a run that failed). cue:feed: a copy of that red cell slides down into the golden row, which makes room and becomes 6 cards (the new one red-edged). cue:end: everything clears (tape too) and the end card lands: 'Score the whole run.' (h1, text) and below it 'Find exactly where it broke.' (body, muted), a single amber rail line drawn under them; small grey credit at the bottom: 'From “AI Agent Evaluation” · DeepEval guide, Confident AI'. All beats finish by ~70.8 s; the end card holds to the end.
